# Peppermint Beadlets

**Category:** Supplements

**Type:** Beadlets


---

## Short Description

👑 Dissolvable beadlet with pure peppermint essential oil
👑 Delivers a refreshing, cooling effect
👑 Convenient form for internal use of Peppermint oil

## Composition and Key Ingredients

▫️ Peppermint essential oil
▫️ Coconut oil (MCT)
▫️ Agar, guar gum, glycerin, sodium alginate, xylitol

## Indications

🔹 Oral hygiene support
🔹 Sensation of clear breathing
🔹 Digestive comfort support

## Directions for Use

🔹 1 beadlet as needed, dissolve in the mouth

## Compatibility with Other doTERRA Products

🔹 dōTERRA SuperMint® Beadlets — expanded mint blend
🔹 Peppermint Softgels® — for internal use with a different dosing focus
🔹 DigestZen® — for comprehensive digestive support

## Interesting Facts

👑 The beadlet shell is agar-based, free of carrageenan and palm oil
👑 Vegan product

## Cautions

> ⚠️ Store in a cool, dry place out of reach of children. Pregnant or nursing women, or individuals under a doctor's care, should consult a physician before use.
